claim_verbatim: If the dual shock holds its current trajectory, models project global fertiliser prices will average 15–20% higher through the first half of 2026.
context: Conditional; he publishes the model band.
source: Essay: War, El Niño, Pestilence, and Famine
resolution_criterion: YES if a recognised fertiliser price basket averages >=15% above pre-shock early-2026 baseline across H1 2026; NO if under 15%.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if a recognised fertiliser price basket averages >=15% above pre-shock early-2026 baseline across H1 2026; NO if under 15%.
notes: Conditional. FAO projected 15–20% if crisis persists; May basket ~USD 595 (+USD 120 vs Feb). Exact H1 average not verified → unresolved.

claim_verbatim: IQ is a very imperfect way to rate AI, but for now, in 2026, it’s say 130-200; it will be in the 1000s by 2028.
source: Essay: The Metabolism of Artificial Intelligence
resolution_criterion: YES if widely cited AI evals by end-2028 are commonly described as order-of-magnitude into the thousands on his informal scale; NO if same order as 2026. Unresolved if no comparable scale.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES if widely cited AI evals by end-2028 are commonly described as order-of-magnitude into the thousands on his informal scale; NO if same order as 2026. Unresolved if no comparable scale.
notes: Metaphorical metric; high chance of unresolved. Inferred 0.90.

claim_verbatim: AI Won't Nuke SaaS: Why the White-Collar Apocalypse Is Just Tech Bros' Dreaming Nonsense These white-collar Armageddon stories are nonsense
context: Title thesis: AI will not cause near-term SaaS industry collapse.
resolution_criterion: YES (forecast correct) if global public SaaS revenue or major SaaS index does not suffer >=40% peak-to-trough collapse by end-2027 driven by AI substitution; NO if such collapse occurs.
resolution_rule_fixed: YES (forecast correct) if global public SaaS revenue or major SaaS index does not suffer >=40% peak-to-trough collapse by end-2027 driven by AI substitution; NO if such collapse occurs.
resolution_source_planned: Gartner/IDC SaaS spend; SaaS equity index
mechanism: Switching cost, integration debt, compliance drag, liability, organisational politics bind AI migration.
notes: Inferred 0.90 that SaaS is not nuked. Probability is P(no collapse).
